WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.sku, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'rows' AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d1, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d2, SUM(quantity) AS units, MIN(quantity) AS minq, MAX(quantity) AS maxq, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END) AS staffq FROM lines
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ctrl', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, SUM(units_sold), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, p.sku
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT l.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(l.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM lines l JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = l.sku AND cp.is_current
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY units DESC, l.sku LIMIT 10

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) AS sold_units
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS ret_units
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sold.sku, sold_units, COALESCE(ret_units,0) AS ret_units, sold_units-COALESCE(ret_units,0) AS net_units
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sku) ORDER BY sold_units DESC, sku LIMIT 6
